notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.117p
notes.content:
Howdy cowpokes,

It’s been a little while, but we’re back with a fresh patch. This update includes fixes for some of the most commonly reported bugs and issues. 

Here’s a list of all the fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where multiplayer games would get sudden FPS drops if the players were far away from each other - especially when some players were in some of the Westwood caves
[*] Fixed an issue where Howard's first treasure map incorrectly showed a white box when viewed. It now displays the correct image
[*] Fixed an issue where clients and servers would sometimes disagree about which objects were on fire, resulting in clients seeing the fire effect lingering on various objects
[*] Fixed an issue where Yara wouldn't show up on the map after moving back to her camp
[*] Fixed an issue where Tumbleville's bulletin board wouldn't show the blue exclamation point when completing ledger tasks for Alice
[*] Fixed an issue where harvesting Poppy Seeds would yield carrots
[*] Fixed an issue where dying while on fire would sometimes set objects around your spawn point on fire
[*] Fixed an issue where Howard's Hideout was called "Missing Translation" on the map
[*] Fixed an issue where the Distillery was called "Broken Distillery" when built
[*] Fixed an issue where some paths were floating above the ground
[*] Fixed an issue where a ladder in Bob's Saloon was placed inside of a wall
[*] Fixed an issue where a floating patch of sand near the ranch would overlap with the floors
[*] Fixed an issue with some buildings that couldn't be removed at Jacques's Edge
[*] Fixed an issue where there was a set of overlapping doors at Jacques's Edge
[*] Fixed an issue where you could fall through the ground at Jacques's Edge
[*] Fixed an issue where some tree stumps in Westwood couldn't be removed
[*] Fixed an issue where you could dismantle the safe in the Lawyer's Office, which would, in some cases, cause the player to get stuck in the intro dialogue
[*] Fixed an issue where Yara's island wasn't properly aligned with the building grid
[*] Fixed an issue where the ledger task "Free The Patridges" would incorrectly have the title "Free the deer"
[*] Fixed an issue where you could keep asking Yara about the caged boars, even after completing the quest where you free them
[*] Fixed an issue where building elements on a slope would be hard and frustrating. This should be easier to do properly now
[*] Fixes some issues where certain construction elements did not highlight or change color with the construction context
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.172p
notes.content:
Howdy cowpokes,

Hotfix [b]1.0.172p[/b] is now live!
We managed to fix the issue where players would not be able to receive a multiplayer code.

NOTE: In this update you will also have all the fixes and changes made with version 1.0.166p.
Here's the list for 1.0.166p in case you haven't seen it:
[h3]General fixes and adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some ammo and weapons would say that their damage type is "Blunt Damage Taken" instead of just "Blunt"
[*] Fixed an issue where some non-red painted elements would could as red for some ledger tasks
[*] Fixed an issue where Tallulah would be running away from her watering can when you first meet her
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Free The Deer"- quest said to talk to Teddy, but it wouldn't progress by doing so
[*] Changed the cabin wall model so that there's no longer a beam overlapping with wall-mounted objects
[*] Fixed an issue where the hanging garden box couldn't be placed on the tall cabin window
[*] Fixed an issue where the pre-existing green saloon walls in Tumbleville couldn't be painted without having to replace them entirely
[*] Fixed an issue where some quest steps would not be marked as completed, even though the whole quest is completed
[*] Fixed an issue where the water trough didn't highlight when hovered over with the hammer
[*] Fixed an issue where the sheriff sign was rotated the wrong way when built
[*] Fixed an issue where changing pages in the Quick Item menu sometimes didn't work
[*] Crafting and construction recipes with three or fewer ingredients now utilize the available space better
[*] Fixed an issue where items equipped with the Quick Items menu would sometimes unequip right as the menu was closed
[*] Fixed an issue where some mounted bandits would sometimes zoom around at super-sonic speed
[*] Fixed an issue where tint effects on activatable objects and NPCs would sometimes linger around
[*] Fixed an issue where Agatha would buy a deprecated cactus stew item
[*] Fixed an issue where Juan didn't sell you the recipe for the leather lasso
[*] Cleaned up the recipes in the journal, so you should be able to fill it out now
[*] Fixed an issue where one step of Howard's Treasure hunt would always be skipped
[*] You can now see discovered totem poles on the world map and minimap - existing save files need to rediscover them before they start showing up!
[*] Fixed a bug where other players would sometimes just be called "Player" on the world map
[*] Fixed an issue where the Hot Tub would appear twice in the construction menu
[*] Improved the way animals load in/unload to reduce the chance of them escaping their enclosures.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could fall through the world at the Fool's Gold Grotto
[/list]
[h3]Steam Deck[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a Large UI mode for playing on Steam Deck and the big screen
[*] Large UI mode is enabled by default when launching the game on Steam Deck
[*] When turned on, text and other UI elements are increased in size
[*] Long item descriptions in the crafting menu and other places are shown as several pages, which automatically cycle through the text
[*] Task requirements and rewards in the ledger are shown using horizontal bars instead of squares to make the text more legible
[*] Fixed an issue where the bumper and trigger buttons on Steam Deck were called “LB”, “RB”, “LT” and “RT” rather than “L1”, “R1”, “L2” and “R2”.
[*] Improved the on-screen keyboard to make the text on the keys more legible
[*] Status effects are now shown in a vertical bar to make the name more legible
[*] Fixed an issue where viewing the details of an item in a shop sometimes had the title text overlap the icon
[/list]

notes.title: Wild Indigo Ranch - Update 1.0.122p Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Howdy cowpokes,[/h2]

We have a new update ready for you - [b]1.0.122p[/b]
In this update, we've added a little bit of new content for you to enjoy. We've also gone through your feedback since the 1.0 launch and made adjustments to gameplay and balancing based on it. Lastly, we've worked on more bug fixes that have been reported. Check out all the changes and fixes in the list below. 
Thank you again for all the feedback and support while we continue to work on improving the game.
[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a hot tub, so you can take a nice warm bath with your friends
[*] Added Sunflowers as a new type of crop
[*] Added black, white, and yellow paint colors
[*] Annabelle will now sell you a hobby horse, which slightly increases your movement speed
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Annabelle now sells a Wooden Trash Can recipe. When built, you can use it to throw away any unwanted craftable items you have lying around. [b]NOTE: you can only delete craftable items[/b]
[*] The ghost cows will no longer wander as far, and will not turn aggressive when being lassoed 
[*] Some animals now have a chance to drop bones, which can be used to make white paint
[*] Tallulah now sells sunflower seeds, which when grown can be used to make yellow paint
[*] You can now see nearby master crafters whom you haven't met on the minimap
[*] You can now see every master crafter you've met on the world map
[*] Changed the master crafter icon on the minimap when tracking a ledger task from a hammer to the face of the master crafter
[*] You can now see dialogue options being considered by other players in multiplayer games
[*] You can now craft stick food at the fireplace
[*] Ledger tasks are now categorized into one of three types: Building tasks, dismantling tasks, and adventure tasks. Each type comes with its own visual theme to make it easier to distinguish
[*] All maps, deeds, and notes should go into your Journal now when read
[/list]
[h2]Game Balance/adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now change how many items you are buying/selling between x1/x5/x10
[*] You can now plant all crops/flowers in both garden boxes and soil patches
[*] When the tin polluter is destroyed, it now leaves behind some acid, which can be used to fill bottles
[*] Reduced the price of the Gatling Gun from 5,000 to 2,500, and the price of the recipe from 10,000 to 5,000
[*] Adjusted combat in Blackrock Cave in Dread Valley, Fool's Gold Grotto, and GritCorp Factory based on community feedback:
[list]
[*] Increased Hitbox for some agents that were hard to hit
[*] Slowed down boar chasing speed
[*] Added cooldown for the Driller Boss's drill in Blackrock Cavern
[*] Increased cooldown for Grit Corp driller's attack in Blackrock Cavern
[*] Made resources respawn in Blackrock Cavern
[*] Tweaked some level design in the GritCorp Factory Cave
[*] Reduced health for Robots and their spawning time
[*] Added explosion effect on Explosive steel arrows
[*] Added cover points to Westwood trees and some construction elements
[*] Poachers were missing from the poacher's camp and have been re-added
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where Juan's milk Quest won't complete when you bring him milk
[*] Fixed an issue where you could pick up items into an inventory slot from which another item was being moved, causing both items to occupy the same slot
[*] Fixed the issue where deeds and treasure maps wouldn't appear in the journal
[*] Fixed an issue where a bandit act in Westwood didn't work as intended
[*] Fixed an issue where jumping over fences with a horse in a multiplayer game would cause the horse to snap back when dismounted
[*] Fixed an issue where Annabelle wouldn't sleep in her bed
[*] Fixed an issue where you couldn’t talk to a quest NPC before bringing a specific quest item
[*] Fixed an issue where you couldn't tell Teddy that you killed the white bat and the black boar
[*] Fixed an issue where players couldn't destroy the rock crushing Sir Lorren in multiplayer
[*] Fixed an issue where players would get screen shake from events in the world that were too far away from them
[*] Fixed an issue where the shovel's digging animations weren’t working
[*] Fixed bug with the Reverend's speech getting stuck at Kasper's answer
[/list]
[h2]Others[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed the white deputy hat into a dark brown Sheriff hat
[*] Fixed an issue where loading screen tips would not be localized, or properly randomized
[*] We made the indigo color more blue
[*] The game will now detect corrupt save files and give you the option to restore a backup from the last session
[/list]
There are some issues that although we have fixed, due to them happening in very unique scenarios, we will continue to keep an eye out for them in case they pop up again. So please let us know if you experience any issues.
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Yara wouldn't go to Yara's Crest
[*] Fixed an issue where Yara wouldn't go to Rocky Falls
[*] Fixed an issue where the Deputy could get stuck at the pier
[*] The hideout in Westwood now respawns if it's destroyed 
[/list]

notes.title: Wild Indigo Ranch 1.0 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]Howdy, cowpokes![/h2]
[h2]WILD INDIGO RANCH 1.0 IS LIVE![/h2]

After a long and exciting journey, the moment we’ve all been waiting for is finally here! We’re thrilled to announce that Wild Indigo Ranch 1.0 is out now! It’s been quite the adventure, full of twists and turns, and we couldn’t have done it without your amazing support and feedback during the development. Thank you!
Whether you’re a new cowpoke or a seasoned cowboy, we’re excited for everyone to jump into our cozy western world. Now, let’s dive into everything you can expect from the 1.0 release of Wild Indigo Ranch.

[h2]What’s New in 1.0?[/h2]

We’ve added a lot of quality-of-life improvements and exciting new features that can be noticed from the beginning of the game. We’ve added a new biome, Westwood, which features a dense forest, making it the perfect place for dangerous wildlife, bandits, and mystery but also a great place to find rare resources and meet new characters.

Here are the highlights:

[h3]Story Update[/h3]

Uncle Howard’s story is finally complete! In the 1.0 update, you’ll meet new characters connected to the story. With their help, explore Westwood, face Grit Corp, and uncover what happened to Uncle Howard.

[h3]New Biome: Westwood[/h3]

Explore Westwood, a dense, mysterious forest filled with dangerous wildlife, bandits, and hidden treasures. This new biome is a strong contrast to the dry and rocky areas of the Wild River Prairie, featuring a more lush and vibrant scenery full of secrets and new things to discover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/ad57713ead6f826d5addb4641d2fe331d6ec335f.png[/img]

[b]New NPCs[/b]: During your adventures in Westwood you will meet an expanded cast of new characters who will help unfold the story of Wild Indigo Ranch and what happened to Uncle Howard. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/e40f154a35a49a040e6697316ebceea0ba789cf4.png[/img]
Teddy - The Hunter

[b]New Quests[/b]: With the new characters also come new quests to fulfill. Join your new friends on their quests, lend a helping hand and they will return the favor.

[b]New Enemies[/b]: On your journey through the woods you also face off against some familiar faces: Grit Corp and bandits who are still in cahoots. Grit Corp are cutting down and destroying the woods, while the bandits are helping them trap animals. You will also come across new threats in the form of hostile boars, bats, and whatever dastardly inventions Grit Corp will throw at you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/2b57c3ada5e13b6495e01c94c87552ccd0214ddf.png[/img]

[b]New Recipes & Construction Elements[/b]: We’ve added many new recipes, meals, and construction elements for you to discover. Enjoy some fine western delicacies like a refreshing milkshake during your breaks from exploring and building your dream ranch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/f5df117c3abdf4fe51682af29e192ee7af85a146.png[/img]

[b]Ledger Overhaul[/b]

After several updates and listening to your feedback, we've improved the way our ledgers work. Completing tasks in the ledger will earn you Trust, which is key to building relationships with the new vendors. Besides trust, you'll also earn cash from these tasks, which you can spend at the vendors to buy new recipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/9839a1d2c2c6dd1f7a0edfa76b26f26bb30cd67a.png[/img]

[b]Vendors[/b]

Vendors have arrived in Wild River Prairie! Build trust with them, and based on their specializations, you can get new construction elements, food recipes, and tool upgrades. The more trust you have, the more rare the wares will be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/1f997ea19885e3bf9a198927c9c4118f4fcef1de.png[/img]

[b]Painting[/b]

Give your ranch a makeover! Unlock painting recipes, gather ingredients, and make your ranch stand out with a splash of color and impeccable style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/8efdb046f112c9776eb63b9b40c662e301fb72b8.png[/img]

[b]Taming[/b]

Taming is back! While taming has long been a part of the game, it was removed because the taming mini-game was hard to understand and didn't feel right. Based on your feedback we’ve made some adjustments and it’s ready to be reintroduced in the game. You can finally give Rosie a much needed break and get yourself a brand-new ride!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/28c48a421640bade4ba12773d25c88b2f1880ba4.png[/img]

[b]Fast Travel[/b]

Wild River prairie is a big place and with the introduction of our Westwood, there is a lot of land to cover. But there is no time to waste when you have people to help or porches to build and you are missing those last two pieces of iron ore that didn’t fit in your backpack because you just found a cool bear hat.

To help out with that we’ve introduced fast travel - just tell the friendly totem where you’d like to go (make an offering - nothing is for free in the West cowpoke!) and you’ll be there in a jiffy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/41edb997677bb595c73c6a21a450e6abd1cc82be.png[/img]

[b]Full Controller Support & Custom Keybindings[/b]

You asked, and we delivered! Wild Indigo Ranch now has full controller support and customizable keybindings for both controllers and keyboards. Play your way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/e1f307a95bfd9305e742ead2eaa7e140851f20ad.png[/img]

[h2]Can I Use My Old Saves?[/h2]

1.0 comes with many new features that did not exist during Early Access. One example of that would be the vendors, which also introduce a currency system, a new way to interact with the characters of the world, and how to learn recipes. Because these systems did not exist before old saves/adventures will not be compatible with all the new features.

To experience all the new content coming with 1.0, everyone will have to start a new adventure/save at launch.

[h2]What’s Next for Wild Indigo Ranch?[/h2]

Our main focus after launch will be fixing any issues players might encounter. At the same time, we’ll be working on ideas for future updates, new content, and quality-of-life improvements. Even after Uncle Howard’s story, there’s plenty of fun to be had in Wild Indigo Ranch! With the world of Wild Indigo Ranch being an open-world sandbox, you can play how you want, for as long as you want even after finishing the main story.

notes.title: Don’t Die in the West is getting a new name, new price and going to Gamescom
notes.content:
[h1]Howdy cowpokes,[/h1]

Don’t Die in the West has been through many changes during Early Access, and today, we’re excited to share what's coming in the next few months.

First, we have some big news - [b]we're changing the game's name[/b]! Don't worry, there's no trouble with the sheriff. Since starting our Early Access, the game has evolved and undergone many significant changes. Your fantastic feedback has shaped it into a cozy and wholesome adventure game. While we still live the action-adventure aspects, we also want you to be able to hang up your spurs and relax with your friends or alone. Maybe even build a trophy room, or grow a pumpkin or two.

The key word here is wholesome. Don’t Die in the West is beloved for its charming art style, quirky characters, story, crafting, and sense of adventure. Because of this, we feel the current name no longer represents the game as well as it should. We know change is hard, and we’re still a bit emotionally attached to the old name, but it's time for something new. So, please welcome our new name: Wild Indigo Ranch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/ae7f94fa67d54ca31e78f56c17a9cc5e3b03e624.png[/img]
With a focus on exploring the Wild West, building, crafting, and unraveling the story, Wild Indigo Ranch better represents what our game is all about. We are working with Steam on changing the name in all the right places, and plan on having it live in the beginning of August.

Now, for our second announcement: On August 5th, [b]we will be increasing the price[/b] of Wild Indigo Ranch to better reflect all the added content that has been introduced during early access. The new price will be $19.99. Until the price increase takes effect, you can still buy it for $12.99/€12.79, and right now, you can get it at a great discount. If you or a friend are thinking about getting the game, now is a great time before the price goes up. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1751350/Dont_Die_In_The_West/

Lastly, we are excited to announce that [b]we will be at Gamescom[/b] this year as part of the Indie Arena Booth. If you are in Cologne, Germany between August 20-25, make sure to visit the Wild Indigo Ranch booth to play the latest version of the game and chat with us.

That’s a lot to take in! We are both nervous and excited about all these changes, but none of it would be possible without your fantastic support. So thank you - your feedback means the world to us! 
Stay tuned for more updates as we move closer to 1.0, and join us on [url=https://x.com/ddinthewest]Twitter [/url]or [url=https://discord.gg/vjrVhWEeVb]Discord [/url]to stay up-to-date with all the latest info!

notes.title: Growing Greens - Farming Update
notes.content:
[b][h2]Howdy, cowpokes! 🤠[/h2][/b]

We are happy to announce that the highly anticipated farming update has arrived. The “Growing Greens - Farming Update” features the first iteration of farming, a revamp of the construction mode, a combat update, and lots of improvements!

[b][h3]Introducing: Farming[/h3][/b]
As one of the most requested features, we are excited to bring farming to Don’t Die in the West. With this update, we are laying down the basics of how it will work, and with your feedback, we will continue building on this foundation in future updates.

To begin your farming empire, you’ll first need to meet with Tallulah, who can show you the ropes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/e3614757533d837bca1449ddf34f45fd748e12d8.gif[/img]

After you’ve helped her out, Tallulah will teach you how to make garden boxes. You can plant seeds in these boxes to grow vegetables. If you water them every day and give them some time, soon they will be ready to harvest by hand!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/2411dc35bdd476e8e82d75db57233b0b02d60cc6.gif[/img]

Once you’ve harvested your first crop, you can eat your fresh veggies raw, or use them in the new recipes coming with this update. To further expand your farm, make sure you stock up on fertile soil, which is crafted from straw and a stinky new ingredient. 

[b][h3]Revamped construction [/h3][/b]
Based on your feedback, we are adjusting the construction mode. The goal is to improve the flow and offer a more tactile feeling to construction that puts you at the center of the experience.

We’ve introduced a new tool, the hammer, which you can equip to enter construction mode. With the hammer equipped, you can edit structures and navigate through menus.

One of the most requested features for the construction mode has finally made its way into the game: Camera control. Specifically, we’ve added camera rotation, and more dithering options while you have the hammer equipped in a construction zone. We hope this will help with item placements and visibility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/904775a5eba1105081ddf8d20d84630db6237a0c.gif[/img]

[b][h3]Improved combat [/h3][/b]
One of the main issues we noticed with combat was enemy awareness. In some cases, enemies didn't notice you even if you were punching them, while in other cases they could spot you moving behind a mountain.

Because of that, we’ve focused on improving enemy awareness states and behavior. The list of changes and tweaks is quite long, but in short, enemy behavior should now be more consistent when interacting with them. For example: Showing suspicion when detecting you at range, before attacking, thus giving you time to hide (which you can now do in tall patches of grass!) 

To make this clearer we’ve added new status icons above enemies (and animations) to show if they are suspicious, attacking, or afraid of you. Together with the behavior changes we hope this will make the combat more fun and readable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/428e2533ab2c98fb40f22fabef76879d811fa7a5.gif[/img]

We have created a new outfit to match the start of your farming adventures, added auto-collect, and many other improvements, tweaks, and fixes. 

As we mentioned in the beginning, we are very excited about this big update and hope you will enjoy it. The team has been hard at work nurturing these new features, but in order to grow them, we need to water them with your suggestions. Share your thoughts, feedback, farms, suggestions, or just a "hi!" with us on [url=https://discord.gg/eqAZjjE2nJ]Discord[/url], [url=https://x.com/DDInTheWest]X[/url], or the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1751350/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url].

Best of howdies,
The Don't Die in the West team

It’s been a while since our last post, but we are back and bringing lots of improvements to the game. We’ve been hard at work implementing new features and reworks to the game based on your feedback.

What to expect from this update? The focus is on quality of life (QoL) reworks for multiple features and adjustments to the game, and just to give you a sneak peek: We have partial controller support now.

Here are some of the major features that have been improved:

[h2]Revamped dialogue system[/h2]
We saw that players had issues with the dialogue tree and didn’t have a clear path on how to proceed. Sometimes it took too long to get out of a dialogue tree (lookin' at you Miss McAbernathy). With some dialogue options being too vague, we decided to take another look under the hood and make some improvements.

We have added icons to the dialogue UI so you can get a clear picture of the dialogue options at a quick glance. They should help you understand which option to pick when looking for a quest, a recipe, or ending a dialogue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/38b5cf6ba042d9338bd15b90365b2cf86805f642.png[/img]

[h2]New notifications system[/h2]
Players often don't notice a new recipe, a skill point, or a new quest they receive. To remind you of this, we have added a notifications system to help you keep track of all your new stuff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/dba033c4d535fcf1f77fb02c08df10ec8894273c.jpg[/img]

[h2]No more extra reading[/h2]
When playing a multiplayer game, each time someone found a new recipe, you had to go to the bookshelf to learn it. When the number of recipes grows fast, it can become frustrating to keep repeating this step. We decided: no more mandatory reading lists! If your buddy learns a new recipe you'll also know it if you are in the world together - no extra effort needed.

If you join a game in progress, you will have to visit the bookshelf, to catch up on all the discovered recipes.

[h2]Improved controller support and M&K buttons layout maps[/h2]
We heard the outcry for controller support and have moved its priority way up. Now the game has partial controller support and an in-game buttons layout map. Mouse & keyboard have also received a button layout map.

We will continue to collect feedback on both types of control schemes and improve them in future patches.

[h2]Reworked navigation paths for NPCs & enemies[/h2]
Many times, enemies ended up inside rocks or in the ground (not by choice). We also had situations where the enemy AI did not know how to reach or move around certain areas. We reworked our navigation system for NPCs and enemies to solve these issues. Now, NPCs should not spawn under the map and enemies should be better at patrolling, plus a bit smarter. We are moving to two-color Rubik’s cubes now! 

Controller button map layout

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/45460232a39ea26c3dd77b399f5de2fa6035e615.png[/img]

Keyboard button map layout

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/6090bc83e96edfd125fbf54df4e9dfba7bff7307.png[/img]

These are some of the major improvements included in the “Quality of Life on the prairie” update. The patch includes a lot more general fixes and adjustments that should give you an overall smoother gameplay experience. We encourage you to jump into the game and experience it for yourself.

We are super happy to be able to share this update with you, as we wanted to address some of the most pressing issues reported by the community. We'd love to hear your thoughts about the game and chat with you over on Steam Discussions or our official Discord.

Best of howdies,
The Don’t Die in the West team

notes.title: Patch 0.5.14b - Deeds & Dams
notes.content:
[h2]Howdy, howdy y’all! [/h2]

Put on your hat and hang on to it ‘cause we have been working on our biggest update yet. Since last time we have listened to the feedback from playtests and made sure to include your suggestions in our roadmap for the game. This update has everything from new quests to worktable reworks and even spooky ghosts! Let’s dig in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/bc0aacfdd60e6ee40d17a8504ecc1f0cd123faec.png[/img]

After watching many new cowboys aimlessly roam the open prairie we thought that a more guided introduction would help with some of the basic mechanics.

At the start of the game, you will arrive at your uncle’s ranch and discover that a lot of things have been left in shambles and it’s up to you to settle the score with a little guidance from a cheery new friend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/0f3563d2302ec67d0e664c7eaade479f8254eb7e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/bc6067bff7d064c60cd535e4a1929aca01680974.png[/img]

With this update, we want to emphasize what it means to own land. We have added the concept of [b]Deeds[/b] which will work as proof of ownership over a piece of land. You are not able to build on a piece of land unless you own the deed for it. This feature is in a very early stage and will evolve as development continues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/fa8f9115008b5b8d3f2027464ca45eceb60ca232.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/c4fb48bee70c7ecf897a6c95416219925faba535.png[/img]

The prairie is expanding, and along with it the number of townspeople in Tumbleville is growing. Hearing about the opportunity for fame and fortune, folks are starting to turn up ready to shoot their shot. Friends or foes? You decide!

With this update, we are introducing [b]Recipes[/b] - documents that teach you to craft new items. Some recipes will be given (or rewarded) to you by [b]master crafters[/b] that you will meet, and some can be found by exploring the prairie and beyond.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/24965d66ce8b37c61db11e921b73a968946476e5.png[/img]

One such master crafter is Yong Tienjiang, the [b]blacksmith[/b] who has joined the growing community of Tumbleville. Besides being a master at bending metal to her will, she might provide you with critical quest clues and a recipe for building a smelter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/b337291ceeee5b81435e192ca851ffda575b2838.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/55823c0c48d8189c94240c19716878b70684925b.png[/img]

Are you itching for the latest hot Tumbleville gossip, and strangely also in need of woodworking tips? Then make sure you stop by [b]Lars the Carpenter[/b] - a master craftsman of the wooden arts and a tireless blabbermouth who can’t resist sharing people’s secrets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/665db308bb8fa5c0cb225398376c8288ae2e604b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/564b7b229053b16ee5ec83630278375829b76ecd.png[/img]

We have introduced [b]random events[/b] to put back the Wild in ‘Wild West’ - what does this mean for your adventures?

Well… brace yourself for some good ol' fashioned cowboy chaos! You'll be bumping into bandit camps, crossing paths with wild animals, lending a hand to folks searching for their prized horse, and dealing with ruthless Gritt Corp. schemers trying to snatch up and ruin this pristine land of ours. So saddle up, and get ready for a wild ride through the ever-changing landscape of the Wild West!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/5fc82c7f1da7721ccfb475784e62543deebbe36b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/7178203bb7acb180d7ea238fa01f5e23c4b17cd1.png[/img]

In your quest for fortune, you’ll need precious metal, meaning you’ll have to dive deep into [b]the mines[/b]. The mines have received a massive overhaul (and are still a work in progress) where we have moved away from randomly generated mineshafts to unique handcrafted levels.. Expect danger, darkness, and deposits of gold. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/5852a6ac015f8e5f3ddf6372df6d54858674bf5c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/4ea9b961ca302cdd67def58433ec40d0f03c9fe0.png[/img]

Want the latest top-shelf weapons and tools? Then you gotta get yourself the best [b]worktables[/b] and that means upgrading them with the latest technology. Doing so will also give you access to more crafting materials to build unique decorations for your ranch. Venture into uncharted territories, lend a warm hand to those in need, or lend some cold lead to some bandits. 
By doing so, you might be rewarded with upgrades for your worktables.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/f4afe24dbed8d32ea394f8e98d612aede8ccc025.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/29bc7ed16d38fe0f61c2685c70aa5c687965f8b0.png[/img]

First of all, a big thanks to all of you who have tried the Playtest already. Your comments, feature suggestions, and bug reports will make sure Don’t Die in the West is a phenomenal Western adventure when we launch into Early Access. Based on your suggestions on Discord we've started to work on dun dun dun.... a Ghost Town. While still in a very early state, make sure you drop by and check in with your friendly neighborhood ghosts. There are rumors about Crazy Pete having trouble with treasure stealing coyotes, maybe you can lend a helping hand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/2a04590c4e1cca2d5caeb7b7a31b5bca1d729c92.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/29f2d3380814e793d6a6ef48283800088363a67b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/15f94f5018b546a1b5e64fa61da55e60a45f3ad1.png[/img]

Another frequently requested feature is to have the natural resources of the prairie respawn. Previously, you could run out of harvestable resources on the prairie, but now we've implemented respawning for grass, and animals. Trees and mineral deposits are currently in the works with more tweaks planned for future patches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/a6b9f8d1a13b13db61b01a65b261ded54452006c.png[/img]

As Gritt Corp expands its greedy hold on the land and poisons its very essence, the people are in dire need of a hero to put a stop to the injustice. As everyone knows, the first step in a revolution is civil disobedience - like peeking over a fence,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/9f75c1247eaab7279c3cc370cfda0862add8d0c8.gif[/img]

Or blowing stuff up

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/f9125c5e1c723d11eddb311e0854a647e477774d.gif[/img]

As they say, the prairie is your oyster!

The prairie keeps growing as we add more features. Make sure you check out the update and let us know on [url=https://discord.gg/vjrVhWEeVb]Discord [/url]all of your thoughts.

If you haven’t joined the Playtest already, don’t waste any more precious time and hop on. The Playtest is live and kickin’ as we speak (you read), drop by our [url=https://discord.gg/vjrVhWEeVb]Discord[/url] and ask for a key in the #request_beta_key channel.

Best of howdies,
The Don’t Die in the West team

notes.title: Patch 0.3.7b - New resources and raging cows
notes.content:
[h2]Howdy, partners![/h2]
After the dust has settled on our first month of beta we would like to take this opportunity to thank everyone for participating and showing us how much you care about this little game of ours. We can’t wait to hear your feedback while you continue exploring the ever-expanding Wild West, where adventure knows no bounds! 

Thanks to your responses on our Discord we have decided to try out a schedule where we strive to update the game once per month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/4ad2ef3fe3d31289aecf24924b69ea455c6c89a3.png[/img]

Before we start, remember that what we are showing is still work in progress so there might be crashes, weird behavior, or stuff missing. Make sure you use the in-game bug reporting tool or the Discord channel to report them.

[b]So with that out of the way let’s venture into Patch Notes:[/b]

[h3][b]New Copper Tier[/b][/h3]
We have noticed the abrupt impact to the gameplay when going from stone to iron and have introduced a new resource in between - copper. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/b08d28d89201992e3c8536bae092ec1c90b0f48f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/d928951f21ae688316077e8ac475b95216ba22b4.png[/img]

With this new resource, we have adjusted some of the recipes and also introduced Copper Tier items: copper axe, pickaxe, shovel, torch, lamp, and bonfire with pot.

Tools and craftables
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/5185a96db359a7caa0b797721152f20bfec3bd8d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Straw Bed[/b][/h3]
In the beginning, we only had one type of bed, which might have been a bit too hard to build, especially in the early stages of the game. So we have introduced a lower tier to allow faster base building out in the wild. Not that fancy, but does its job! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/8409bc14396ac5323d163a75afd4c8a59db519e9.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Cheap Chest[/b][/h3]
We heard you loud and clear about the chest problem:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/126c09247606977eb6ae4f85bb7183ed1aa8d42d.png[/img]

So expect to be able to craft a cheaper version that has more space for items. Progress!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/3b94bf43165d56f94559f41785c218c75c5e3f10.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Quests UI (WIP)[/b][/h3]
Quests are important in any cowboy's journey and remembering them even more so. Thus we started implementing a Quest Log so you can keep track of your progress. Mind you the UI is still a work in progress so it won’t be shiny in all the places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/077a37e433b640a3ebf4ddb41829d14e30b84b69.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Partial new UI[/b][/h3]
Besides Quest UI you’ll be able to notice new UI in other places, this is all part of our UI overhaul. The UI overhaul will continue over multiple future updates. This also includes [b]BIGGER[/b] description text, as we have seen in some playthroughs that people were struggling with reading it. (Sorry about that 😣)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/d3430c2eb56648157fce5c44a667493bfcedac6d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Charging Cow[/b][/h3]
Cows will no longer stand around idle and be cute while you do all your shenanigans. Try to mess with them and you’ll know bovine wrath! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/babdb356688d827810ee8a2d8bfdaad20ec31a73.gif[/img]

[h3][b]No profession in the character creator[/b][/h3]
Due to the low impact, it had on the start of the game, professions have been removed. Decide your path by the way you survive and thrive in the wild.

[h3][b]Butter hair[/b][/h3]
With croissant ears & taco nose, we had to top it off with some smooth looking butter hair.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/6664050353c78d50eb6c4fd3198f2ae17c419223.png[/img]

[h3][b]Cactus Hat[/b][/h3]
Fashion has always been timeless so the Wild West is getting more hats. Show off your style even with a lack of resources. Introducing: the Cactus Hat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/b49354bf2494691ed31d94f4d62fcc250257ea4d.png[/img]

We are eager to see y'all play and to hear your thoughts. Make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/vjrVhWEeVb]Discord[/url] if you haven’t already and let us know how the cowboy life is treating you.

In case you haven’t started playing already, what are you waiting for?! The Beta is LIVE right now so make sure to go sign up for a key on [url=https://www.dontdieinthewest.gg/signup]dontdieinthewest.gg/signup[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/vjrVhWEeVb]Discord[/url] and ask for a key in the #request_beta_key channel.

Now, as the sun sets over this batch of updates I leave you with this small teaser of what is to come in the future of Don’t Die in the West!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42308378/daf45018f01e37dbcdf62e1d72d1a7d55ae35a3b.png[/img]

Warm howdies,
The Don't Die in the West team
